risks.risk: Engine may have internal damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Video or photos showing the engine running, or a mechanic's inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with major wear

risks.risk: Engine may be missing critical components (e.g., ECU, sensors, timing chain)
risks.proof: Full view of the engine bay or a complete parts list with photos of all components.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete or with missing parts

risks.risk: Engine may have been in an accident or has water damage
risks.proof: Photos of the engine block, oil pan, and cylinder head for signs of cracks or corrosion.

proof_requests: Video of the engine running or a mechanic's inspection report.
Photos of the engine block, oil pan, and cylinder head to check for damage.
Full view of the engine bay to confirm all components are present.
response.reason: The engine is clearly identified as a Toyota 2GR-FE V6 from the visible markings on the cover. The seller's claim is supported by the photo. While there are hidden risks related to internal condition and completeness, these are standard for used engines and do not prevent pricing. The item can be priced at its worst case (as not working or incomplete) until further proof is provided.
